how: We read the website of every Los Angeles wedding venue listed on Lazo (267 listings, 232 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: hotel meeting-room pages, a directory listing with no venue site behind it, sister ballrooms of the same company, and same-day marriage storefronts. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: If the ceremony is outdoors near the coast, what is the plan for June gloom in the morning and wind off the water at sunset?
What is the noise curfew and the last-call time? Many Los Angeles neighborhoods and hillside venues cut amplified music early.
Which parts are included in the site fee, and what are the guest minimums for a Friday, Saturday or Sunday?

picks.name: Lindley-Scott House
picks.blurb: A 1911 house in Azusa that has hosted weddings and receptions for the San Gabriel Valley since 1978. The Lindley-Scott House has an on-site wedding chapel open year-round and four acres of gardens near the San Gabriel Mountains, with banquet facilities and catering handled by the venue.

picks.name: Eden Gardens
picks.blurb: Family-run outdoor venue in Moorpark, 30 to 40 minutes outside Los Angeles, with a private cottage and bungalow for getting ready. Eden Gardens prints its pricing: a base fee of $7,600 for ceremony and reception, with guest minimums of 100 on Fridays, 125 on Saturdays and 75 on Sundays.

picks.name: Rancho De Las Palmas - Moorpark, CA
picks.blurb: An outdoor Moorpark venue with tropical palms and garden views plus an indoor reception option. Rancho de las Palmas introduces its coordinators by name: Laura was the second bride to marry there and has coordinated hundreds of weddings since 1996, and Jenn said her vows there in 2004.

picks.name: Walnut Grove Weddings
picks.blurb: Five acres set aside on a family's 120-acre working ranch in Moorpark, minutes from Los Angeles. Tierra Rejada Ranch was founded in 1935 by Monroe Everett, whose grandfather ranched the area from 1889, and Walnut Grove publishes separate wedding and other-event pricing pamphlets.

picks.name: LA Celebrations Banquet Halls
picks.blurb: Built in 1929 as a luxury hotel, LA Celebrations is a historic Los Angeles event space that says it has hosted celebrity weddings and society parties. The main ballroom anchors the venue, and you request a wedding brochure through the site rather than reading prices online.

picks.name: The Oviatt
picks.blurb: An Art Deco penthouse and rooftop in downtown Los Angeles, run by the Olive & Grand event management team. The Oviatt's general manager Gabe has over 15 years operating venues including the Shrine Auditorium and Hollywood Palladium, and the team counts more than 60 combined years in events.

picks.name: NOOR Events | Venue | Catering
picks.blurb: Two indoor ballrooms and two outdoor spaces in Pasadena. NOOR opened its doors on September 10, 2010 and says it has since hosted thousands of weddings alongside galas, fundraisers and milestone parties, with catering done in house.

picks.name: L.A. Banquets - Glenoaks Ballroom
picks.blurb: Glenoaks Ballroom is one of the L.A. Banquets venues founded by Sebooh Sarkissian, a company that traces its story to 1986 and describes itself as a steward of life's most meaningful experiences. Catering is in house, with menus built around your preferences, and the company runs sister venues across Glendale and the Valley.

picks.name: Bexx Secret Garden & Bexx's Celebrations & Creative Cuisine
picks.blurb: A private garden hidden behind a 1920s English cottage in the NoHo Arts District, planted by the owner herself. Bexx Secret Garden hosts micro weddings of 20 to 80 guests, and the menu, cake, florals and design all come from one person and her team, so there is no juggling of vendors.

picks.name: FantaSea Yachts
picks.blurb: A family-owned fleet of private yachts in Marina del Rey that has hosted weddings and events since 1980, for 12 to 250 guests. FantaSea Yachts publishes a wedding page that compares vessels, capacities and starting prices so you can pick a boat before you call.

picks.name: Queen Mary Wedding Chapel
picks.blurb: Weddings aboard the Queen Mary in Long Beach, with 14 Art Deco salons across more than 80,000 square feet of event space. The ship pairs its historic rooms with contemporary amenities, from intimate gatherings to grand events, with a weddings, group sales and catering team as the contact.

picks.name: Albertson Wedding Chapel
picks.blurb: A Los Angeles wedding chapel operating since 1974 that offers instant legal marriage as well as all-inclusive micro weddings and receptions for up to 54 guests. Albertson prints its ceremony pricing, from $379, and was written up by Vogue for its elegance and simplicity.
